newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian state insurer doubles capital base.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian state insurer doubles capital base.

text.p: State-owned National Insurance Corp of Nigeria (NICON) said on Thursday it had raised its capital base to one billion naira from 500 million to boost its business and maintain its leading position in the industry.

NICON's chairman Umaru Alkaleri told the annual general meeting in Abuja that the company recorded a gross premium income of 9.96 billion naira in 1995, an increase of 192 percent over the three billion recorded in 1994.
Profit after tax rose by 43 percent to 813 million naira in 1995 from 569 million in the year before while the company's investment income rose to 139.95 million from 61.78 million.
NICON is wholly owned by the federal government and is the country's biggest insurance firm with 42 branches nation-wide and a branch office in London.
